learning_notes.text: Synthetic observed user instruction, project Aster support triage convention v1: preserve input order and duplicate ticket ids. A safety_hold exactly true takes precedence: route HOLD, reason blocked. Otherwise severity >= 4 gives route FAST, reason urgent; severity < 4 gives route QUEUE, reason routine. This convention applies only to Aster and to equivalent renamed fields explicitly mapped to severity/safety_hold. A newer explicit current-task contract overrides any of these defaults. Do not apply it to another project.

Synthetic observed user instruction, project Boreal archived support triage convention v1: preserve input order. If safety_hold is true, route PAUSE, reason manual. Otherwise severity >= 3 gives route EXPRESS, reason high; lower severity gives route BACKLOG, reason normal. This is only the archived Boreal v1 rule, not Aster; an explicit current contract has precedence.
